## Overview

This notebook compares single-epoch and multi-epoch likelihood surfaces under
identical rates for both spine and non-spine formulations, highlighting where
the maxima agree or diverge.

## Setup

```{python}
# ruff: noqa: E402
import json
import os
from collections.abc import Callable
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import altair as alt
import jax.numpy as jnp
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display

from bdpinf import find_project_root
from bdpinf.models.math_ages import (
    calculate_non_spine_ages_log_lik,
    calculate_spine_ages_log_lik,
)
from bdpinf.visualization import save_chart

figures_dir = find_project_root() / "figures" / "validation" / "single_epoch"
figures_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
```

```{python}
# Test case from failing unit test
ages = jnp.array([15.0])
birth_rate_val = jnp.array([0.02])
death_rate_val = jnp.array([0.01])
T = jnp.array([40.0])

# Multi-epoch with identical rates
multi_times = jnp.array([20.0, 40.0])

n_epochs = len(multi_times)
```

## Likelihood surface comparison

```{python}
birth_rate_grid = np.linspace(0.005, 0.05, 70)
death_rate_grid = np.linspace(0.002, 0.03, 70)


def compute_surface(
    log_lik_fn: Callable[..., Any],
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, tuple[float, float], tuple[float, float]]:
    single_vals = np.full(
        (len(death_rate_grid), len(birth_rate_grid)), np.nan, dtype=np.float64
    )
    multi_vals = np.full_like(single_vals, np.nan)

    for i, mu in enumerate(death_rate_grid):
        for j, lam in enumerate(birth_rate_grid):
            lam_t = jnp.array([lam])
            death_rate_t = jnp.array([mu])
            single = log_lik_fn(lam_t, death_rate_t, ages, T)
            if j == 0 and i == 0:
                print(f"{jnp.full(n_epochs, lam)} and {lam_t}")
                print(f"{jnp.full(n_epochs, lam).shape} and {ages.shape}")
            multi = log_lik_fn(
                jnp.full(n_epochs, lam),
                jnp.full(n_epochs, mu),
                ages,
                multi_times,
            )
            single_vals[i, j] = float(single)
            multi_vals[i, j] = float(multi)

    single_max_idx = np.unravel_index(np.nanargmax(single_vals), single_vals.shape)
    multi_max_idx = np.unravel_index(np.nanargmax(multi_vals), multi_vals.shape)

    single_max = (
        birth_rate_grid[single_max_idx[1]],
        death_rate_grid[single_max_idx[0]],
    )
    multi_max = (birth_rate_grid[multi_max_idx[1]], death_rate_grid[multi_max_idx[0]])

    return single_vals, multi_vals, single_max, multi_max


(
    non_spine_single_vals,
    non_spine_multi_vals,
    non_spine_single_max,
    non_spine_multi_max,
) = compute_surface(calculate_non_spine_ages_log_lik)

(
    spine_single_vals,
    spine_multi_vals,
    spine_single_max,
    spine_multi_max,
) = compute_surface(calculate_spine_ages_log_lik)

(
    non_spine_single_max,
    non_spine_multi_max,
    spine_single_max,
    spine_multi_max,
)
```

```{python}
# Per-cell bin widths for the regular grid
_lam_step = float(birth_rate_grid[1] - birth_rate_grid[0])
_mu_step = float(death_rate_grid[1] - death_rate_grid[0])


def _build_hm_df(vals: np.ndarray) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for i, mu in enumerate(death_rate_grid):
        for j, lam in enumerate(birth_rate_grid):
            rows.append(
                {"lambda": float(lam), "mu": float(mu), "log_lik": float(vals[i, j])}
            )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def _hm_panel(
    vals: np.ndarray,
    max_lam: float,
    max_mu: float,
    title: str,
    color_scale: alt.Scale,
) -> alt.LayerChart:
    df = _build_hm_df(vals)
    hm = (
        alt.Chart(df)
        .mark_rect()
        .encode(
            x=alt.X(
                "lambda:Q",
                bin=alt.Bin(step=_lam_step),
                title="λ",
                axis=alt.Axis(format=".3f", tickCount=5),
            ),
            y=alt.Y(
                "mu:Q",
                bin=alt.Bin(step=_mu_step),
                title="μ",
                axis=alt.Axis(format=".3f", tickCount=5),
            ),
            color=alt.Color("mean(log_lik):Q", scale=color_scale, legend=None),
        )
        .properties(width=220, height=180)
    )
    dot = (
        alt.Chart(pd.DataFrame({"lambda": [max_lam], "mu": [max_mu]}))
        .mark_circle(color="white", size=80, opacity=0.9)
        .encode(x="lambda:Q", y="mu:Q")
    )
    return (hm + dot).properties(title=title)


# Shared viridis scale for absolute panels, redblue for diff panels
_abs_vals = np.stack(
    [non_spine_single_vals, non_spine_multi_vals, spine_single_vals, spine_multi_vals]
)
_abs_min = float(np.nanmin(_abs_vals))
_abs_max = float(np.nanmax(_abs_vals))
_viridis = alt.Scale(domain=[_abs_min, _abs_max], scheme="viridis")

_diff_ns = non_spine_multi_vals - non_spine_single_vals
_diff_sp = spine_multi_vals - spine_single_vals
_diff_ext = float(np.nanmax(np.abs(np.stack([_diff_ns, _diff_sp]))))
_redblue = alt.Scale(domain=[-_diff_ext, _diff_ext], scheme="redblue")

_row1 = alt.hconcat(
    _hm_panel(
        non_spine_single_vals, *non_spine_single_max, "Non-spine single-epoch", _viridis
    ),
    _hm_panel(
        non_spine_multi_vals, *non_spine_multi_max, "Non-spine multi-epoch", _viridis
    ),
    _hm_panel(_diff_ns, *non_spine_single_max, "Non-spine multi − single", _redblue),
)
_row2 = alt.hconcat(
    _hm_panel(spine_single_vals, *spine_single_max, "Spine single-epoch", _viridis),
    _hm_panel(spine_multi_vals, *spine_multi_max, "Spine multi-epoch", _viridis),
    _hm_panel(_diff_sp, *spine_single_max, "Spine multi − single", _redblue),
)
fig = alt.vconcat(_row1, _row2).properties(title="Likelihood Surface Comparison")
display(fig)
save_chart(fig, "vse10_likelihood_surfaces", output_dir=figures_dir)
```

## Slice comparison at fixed mu

```{python}
mu_fixed = 0.01
non_spine_single_line = []
non_spine_multi_line = []
spine_single_line = []
spine_multi_line = []

for lam in birth_rate_grid:
    lam_t = jnp.array([lam])
    death_rate_t = jnp.array([mu_fixed])
    non_spine_single = calculate_non_spine_ages_log_lik(lam_t, death_rate_t, ages, T)
    non_spine_multi = calculate_non_spine_ages_log_lik(
        jnp.full(n_epochs, lam),
        jnp.full(n_epochs, mu_fixed),
        ages,
        multi_times,
    )
    spine_single = calculate_spine_ages_log_lik(lam_t, death_rate_t, ages, T)
    spine_multi = calculate_spine_ages_log_lik(
        jnp.full(n_epochs, lam),
        jnp.full(n_epochs, mu_fixed),
        ages,
        multi_times,
    )
    non_spine_single_line.append(float(non_spine_single))
    non_spine_multi_line.append(float(non_spine_multi))
    spine_single_line.append(float(spine_single))
    spine_multi_line.append(float(spine_multi))

_n = len(birth_rate_grid)
line_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "lambda": list(birth_rate_grid) * 4,
        "log_lik": (
            non_spine_single_line
            + non_spine_multi_line
            + spine_single_line
            + spine_multi_line
        ),
        "series": (
            ["non-spine single"] * _n
            + ["non-spine multi"] * _n
            + ["spine single"] * _n
            + ["spine multi"] * _n
        ),
    }
)
line_fig = (
    alt.Chart(line_df)
    .mark_line()
    .encode(
        x=alt.X("lambda:Q", title="birth rate (λ)"),
        y=alt.Y("log_lik:Q", title="log-likelihood"),
        color=alt.Color("series:N", legend=alt.Legend(title=None, orient="top")),
    )
    .properties(
        title=f"Log-likelihood slice at death rate = {mu_fixed}",
        width=700,
        height=300,
    )
)
display(line_fig)
save_chart(line_fig, "vse10_slice", width=300, height=200, output_dir=figures_dir)
```

## Single point check

```{python}
non_spine_single = calculate_non_spine_ages_log_lik(
    birth_rate_val, death_rate_val, ages, T
)
non_spine_multi = calculate_non_spine_ages_log_lik(
    jnp.full(n_epochs, float(birth_rate_val[0])),
    jnp.full(n_epochs, float(death_rate_val[0])),
    ages,
    multi_times,
)
spine_single = calculate_spine_ages_log_lik(birth_rate_val, death_rate_val, ages, T)
spine_multi = calculate_spine_ages_log_lik(
    jnp.full(n_epochs, float(birth_rate_val[0])),
    jnp.full(n_epochs, float(death_rate_val[0])),
    ages,
    multi_times,
)
(
    float(non_spine_single),
    float(non_spine_multi),
    float(non_spine_multi - non_spine_single),
    float(spine_single),
    float(spine_multi),
    float(spine_multi - spine_single),
)
```
